feeds.title: Ocean Legacy Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Ocean Legacy Foundation has a primary mandate to research, educate and demonstrate the socio-economic and environmental benefits produced by managing plastic material streams that are treated as part of our Urban & Remote Waste Plastics Program. Our vision is to assist local and international communities that do not have the necessary provisions to develop tools such as long-term education, shoreline clean-up efforts, and plastic to fuel technologies.

feeds.title: Ocean Blue Project Blog
feeds.description: Environmental News and Blog about conservation, river restoration projects, microplastics from the Ocean, and ocean cleanup volunteers. Ocean Blue Project is a non-profit organization whose mission is to protect and conserve the environment through education, by providing service-learning projects, enhancing wildlife habitats, protecting clean water, and biodiversity, by reducing pollution.

feeds.title: Santa Barbara Channelkeeper Blog
feeds.description: Santa Barbara Channelkeeper is a grassroots non-profit organization dedicated to protecting and restoring the Santa Barbara Channel and its watersheds. Through science-based advocacy, education, fieldwork, and enforcement, Channelkeeper defend our community's right to clean water and informs, inspires, and empowers people to speak and act for our waterways.

feeds.title: Beach Necessities Blog
feeds.description: In our blog, we educate people on the impacts of ocean pollution and what is the reason behind it. BeachNecessities manufactures beach products with a focus on sustainability, both in the products we carry as well as in protecting the health of the ocean and the human race, given the impacts of climate change, overfishing and plastic pollution.

feeds.title: Sea Save Blog
feeds.description: Sea Save Foundation stands witness to the health of the oceans and the threats they face, we document problems and develop solutions, arm people with knowledge, and tools so they can make a difference. Our mission is to generate consciousness and encourage stewardship of natural ecosystems while continuing with other charitable educational activities associated with this purpose. Sea Save Foundation strives to protect oceans by raising awareness about the beauty of marine ecosystems and their fundamental importance to human survival.

feeds.title: BRACENET Blog
feeds.description: You want to stay up to date on the state of the oceans and what's happening in marine conservation? Then join our Ocean Club Network and receive regular updates! Learn more about us and our work as a sustainable company fighting against ghost nets. We want the oceans to be as they once were - free of plastic! That's why we recover ghost nets and upcycle them into new products, which are your contribution to the protection of our oceans.

feeds.title: Oceana Blog
feeds.description: Oceana Canada blog shares information about the work and activities we carry out in order to reduce ocean pollution and recover the fish population of certain species that have become extinct due to overfishing. Oceana Canada is an independent charity established to restore Canadian oceans to health & abundance affiliated with Oceana. Our goal is to save the oceans and feed the world.

feeds.title: Seaside Sustainability Blog
feeds.description: Seaside Sustainability is a non-profit organization, our mission is to protect and restore our oceans by educating people of all ages about the critical issues that threaten our environment; promoting best practices for sustainability, and inspiring meaningful advocacy and hands-on action. we strive to ensure the healthy future of oceans, rivers, wetlands, and estuaries around the world.

feeds.title: Ocean Visions Blog
feeds.description: News and Perspectives from Ocean Visions and our Partners. We are one of the leading ocean research and academic institutions that help identify, develop, evaluate, and test solutions to ocean challenges The mission of Ocean Visions is to develop innovative and durable solutions to complex challenges facing our ocean.

feeds.title: As You Sow Blog » Ocean+Plastics
feeds.description: The As You Sow blog has all our latest analyses of the biggest changes we're making with shareholders to make the world safe for future generations. Founded in 1992, As You Sow empowers shareholders to change corporations for good. Our mission is to promote environmental and social corporate responsibility through shareholder advocacy, coalition building, and innovative legal strategies to protect our oceans.

feeds.title: Plastic Oceans Blog
feeds.description: Plastic Oceans International is a US-based non-profit organization whose goal is to end plastic pollution and foster sustainable communities worldwide. Read our ongoing collection of educational blog content that informs on the topics of plastic pollution and sustainability.

feeds.title: Oceanness Blog
feeds.description: The only blog you'll need - sea for yourself! Here we regularly post sustainability hacks, eco-friendly fashion tips, and how we, together, can save the ocean. Oceanness is a purpose-driven apparel brand, created to save the ocean. from eco-friendly & sustainable apparel made from recycled plastic to biodegradable packaging, everything we do is for the love of our ocean.

feeds.title: Sea Smart Blog
feeds.description: On our blog, dive into great stories to get you excited about ocean conservation, and get a sneak peek at what happens behind the scenes at Sea Smart. Sea Smart's mission is to deliver fun, action-oriented, and solutions-based programs that empower people to love and protect our oceans through fun school programs, workshops, and summer camps!

feeds.title: OPDERA.ORG Blog
feeds.description: OPDERA, is a nonprofit organization dedicated to raising awareness about plastic debris in the world's oceans. We sail to the Great Pacific Garbage Patch to show you what is there. We provide data, education, and resources to raise awareness of this disaster and mobilize the millions of people needed to correct this course of ocean destruction and begin to repair our oceans. Use our resources to educate yourself. Raise awareness by spreading the word.

feeds.title: Water Witch Blog
feeds.description: Water Witch are experts in Marine Waste Management, Keep up with the latest news and opinions on ways to reduce marine pollution on our blog. We build trash and litter boats to clean up plastics and debris from waterways around the world. Our goal is to provide cost-effective, efficient solutions to help clean up our marine environment.

feeds.title: Clear Blue Sea Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is to educate people on the causes of ocean pollution and the harm that it is causing to marine life and if not treated what our future will look like. Clear Blue Sea is a nonprofit dedicated to cleansing the oceans of plastic pollution. Our mission is to help ensure the survival of the marine ecosystem and the health of the maritime economy by removing macro and microplastic debris from our oceans and returning the marine environment back to clear blue seas.

feeds.title: Seas & Straws Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Jana and I'm a traveler, a nomad, a rover, a wanderer. The Seas and Straws Blog keep you informed about all things concerning plastic pollution and offers tips and tricks on how to lead a plastic-free, zero-waste life. Our goal is to provide the best alternative materials and the best everyday household items made from these materials. After that, start making your home plastic-free, room by room.

feeds.title: Poseidomm Blog
feeds.description: We share all information about our photochemistry research and educational activities carried out to increase awareness of ocean pollution and its effects through our blog. POSEIDON aims at studying the interaction of anthropogenic plastic pollutants with natural organic matter cycling in the top oceanic layer, as well as photochemical processes involving these natural and anthropogenic compounds.

feeds.title: Plastic Ethics Blog
feeds.description: At Plastic Ethics, we think nothing is impossible. We are the cleanup and recycling information portal. We have hope in people, companies, and associations to be driven with creativity, engineering, good will to tackle the assignment to clean up the planet from plastic and invent the circular economy of tomorrow.

feeds.title: CuriOcean Blog
feeds.description: CuriOcean stems from the idea of meeting the demand to combine the urgent need to raise awareness on marine conservation issues and implement an effective way to share the information. The primary goal of this project is to bring a sense of wonder and excitement about the ocean to participants by educating junior and high school students in the hope that they will feel inspired to become leaders for marine conservation efforts.

feeds.title: Plastic Pollution Coalition News
feeds.description: The blog delivers information about all aspects of plastic pollution and its interconnections. Plastic Pollution Coalition is a growing global alliance of individuals, organizations, businesses, and policymakers working toward a world free of plastic pollution and its toxic impacts on humans, animals, waterways, oceans, and the environment. The mission of the Plastic Pollution Coalition is to measurably reduce plastic pollution and its toxic impacts on people, animals, the ocean, and the environment.

feeds.title: Clear Seas
feeds.description: Clear Seas is an independent, not-for-profit research center that provides impartial and fact-based information about marine shipping in Canada. Get answers to common questions and learn about important issues related to marine shipping. Our mission is to be the leading source of credible, fact-based information to bring clarity to decision-making for safe and sustainable marine shipping.

feeds.title: Seattle Aquarium
feeds.description: We strive to bring families and the community together in awe and understanding of the ocean and its importance to life on Earth. Founded in 1977, the Seattle Aquarium serves as the largest platform for ocean conservation and engagement in the Pacific Northwest. With a mission of Inspiring the Conservation of Our Marine Environment.

feeds.title: Ocean Generation
feeds.description: We share educational content about reducing plastic use and how we can stop plastic from reaching the ocean within a generation. We are empowering an inclusive global movement to tackle Ocean threats through science and storytelling.

feeds.title: UGA Marine Extension and Georgia Sea Grant
feeds.description: UGA Marine Extension and Georgia Sea Grant provide research, education, training, and science-based outreach to assist Georgia in solving problems and realizing opportunities for its coastal and marine environments. By advancing research, education and training, and outreach, We promote the economic, cultural, and environmental health of Georgia's coast and prepare citizens to become good stewards of coastal ecosystems and watershed resources.

feeds.title: Positive Change for Marine Life Blog
feeds.description: They share marine conservation solutions through understanding, education, and respect. Founded in 2012, Our mission is to create long-term profitable change in regards to marine conservation issues worldwide. Our key focus is to address marine debris and pollution, which is having a devastating impact on marine ecosystems, as well as on human health.
